summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitting a press release announcing Titan Mining Corporation's schedule to release Q1 2026 financial results and host a conference call on May 13, 2026. There is no special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or other corporate event. The press release is purely a routine earnings announcement and quarterly update call invitation, with no mention of any material corporate transaction or structural change. As such, it does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
